newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Monday, with falls in Tokyo futures keeping interest thin, traders said.
They said there were enquiries from Bridgestone and Michelin for October shipments but not deals were done.
"They were looking to buy at 44.00 cents/lb but the offers for October are at 44.25 cents," one trader said.
Traders said that a general decline in Tokyo rubber futures as caution over price increases last week triggered technical-driven sales dampened local sentiment.

"Tokyo is one of the very few leads available in the market at the moment," one trader said. "Most of the local players were in Bali over the weekend for a meeting and are slowing making their way back into the market."
Traders said the weather in the key growing region of Medan in North Sumatran was good, adding that the days were hot with intermittent rains at night.
"This is very good weather for rubber," one said. "But the poor prices are discouraging many tappers from working. They would rather do something else that is more profitable."

Traders said September SIR20 offers were quoted at 44.00 cents/lb fob Medan, and at 44.25 cents for October, 43.75-44.00 cents fob Palembang and Surabaya, 43.75 cents fob Padang and 43.50 cents fob Pontianak and Jambi.
